items.text: Round-2 answers (d1=A, d2=A, d3=B, d4=A) have been incorporated into conclusion.md. The conclusion's prior 'Round 2 open questions' / 'Pending direction' sections have been retired in favor of a fully-locked design contract: retry+backoff+auto-pagination wrapped inside the GitHubClient (d1=A), GHE supported in V1 via an optional APIBaseURL credential field (d2=A), PR description template omits unavailable dimensions and renders a STALE badge for stale ones (d3=B), and GitHubClient is a concrete interface with no VCSProviderClient super-interface (d4=A).

Findings restructured: Findings 1, 6, and 7 were updated to reflect the locked answers; a new Finding 10 documents the GHE factory branch and the APIBaseURL validation posture. The Limitations section dropped four resolved items (rate-limit layering, GHE deferral, partial-data policy, multi-provider scope) and now lists only genuine open ends (token rotation UX, template render-against-real-payload validation, App-vs-PAT future, hypothetical multi-VCS, large-repo pagination).

Actions section is now concrete and unconditional: update spec context for execute/gct-github-pr-api and execute/gct-github-release-api with the locked contract; add a GitHub Integration sub-section to scenarios/git-control-tower/PRD.md noting V1 non-goals and the Service + APIBaseURL credential deltas; create one chore backlog item for documenting PAT scopes in the credentials UI. No initiative depends_on changes, no sibling deletions, no multi-VCS research item created (d4=A explicitly closed that question).

Initiative-scope cross-check passed: all five members of gct-github-integration remain valid as designed. The 'Create backlog item (chore)' for PAT-scopes documentation is justified (UI/docs concern, not API surface; would otherwise block execute/gct-github-pr-api on tangential work). No 'Update initiative' action is needed — priority and depends_on remain correct.

Remaining gaps are limitations, not blockers: (a) rendering the PR-description template against a real partial-coverage ReviewDimensions payload to confirm the Markdown reads cleanly is best done as part of execute/gct-github-pr-api implementation, not additional research; (b) token rotation/revocation UX is a small follow-up once the credential delta lands; (c) App-based auth and multi-VCS are explicit V1 non-goals that become research items only if a real driving requirement appears. The item is ready to advance to status=ready and unblock its two execute downstream items.

plan_updates: Promoted all four round-2 decisions (d1=A wrap retry+pagination inside GitHubClient, d2=A ship GHE in V1 via APIBaseURL, d3=B omit-unavailable + STALE-badge for review dimensions, d4=A concrete GitHubClient with no multi-provider abstraction) from open-questions/pending-direction state to fully locked design contract in conclusion.md. Updated Summary, Findings 1/3/6/7, added Finding 10 (GHE factory and validation), tightened Limitations to remaining genuine open ends, and converted the Actions section from a conditional 'Pending direction' shape to a concrete, unconditional list. All five readiness dimensions raised to 3/3 — design contract is fully specified and the two execute children can pick it up directly.
